name: buzz
one_liner: A self-hosted, Slack-like workspace where AI agents and humans share the same channels, with every message, code change, and approval logged as a searchable, signed event.
buyer: An engineering team lead who wants AI coding agents working alongside the team in one auditable workspace instead of scattered bot DMs and chat logs nobody can search.
business_use_cases: An engineering team runs feature branches as chat channels, so code review, CI results, and the merge decision all live in one searchable thread.
A security-conscious company self-hosts it so AI agents can triage bugs and answer 'have we seen this before?' without exposing data to a third-party SaaS.
An agency selling 'AI-augmented engineering teams' uses it as the shared workspace where their human developers and client-facing AI agents collaborate visibly.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting or relay-as-a-service for teams who don't want to self-host the Nostr relay.
Setup and integration consulting wiring a client's existing agents and repos into a self-hosted instance.

steal_this: Self-host one instance this weekend and pitch it to a small dev team as a private alternative to Slack plus a separate bot dashboard.
